Dear customer,

Dear Georg Aigner,

Thank you for your letter and your quote; we have checked it against our own data and cannot accept the increase as proposed.

We commit to a binding volume of 94800 pieces a year over 24 months, our full need for this part, as in our demand forecast (fc:370010@2026-09).
Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars (PPI-C2431) changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Your on-time delivery averaged 88.2% over the last two scorecard quarters (sc:70710@2026Q2, sc:70710@2026Q3).

We have set out 3 packages below. Each would be an acceptable basis for agreement for us; if none fits, please tell us which term is the hardest for you:
1. EUR 4.67 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 5% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24 months
2. EUR 4.59 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 5% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 14 days net, 24 months
3. EUR 4.56 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 0% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24 months

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part? And what would you need from us to move further on the price?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
